$comment: Generated by tests/fixtures/progressScenarios.js from services/claimProgress.js (buildFarmerProgress); never edit by hand. `response` is a GET /claims/:id/progress body; `examples` holds the builder output for every scenario (fixed clock `now`). Vocabulary: docs/architecture/progress-contract-v1.json.

draft_no_photos.description: Draft claim without photos or land documents.

draft_ready.description: Draft with photos and a land document, not submitted yet.

submitted_fresh.description: Just submitted: every planned check is queued.

checks_running.description: Photo, land-document, weather and satellite checks running.

retrying_event_today.description: Event today: provider retries scheduled and the post-event satellite window not open yet.

land_documents_queued.description: A land document waiting for its first examination.

held_ai_no_damage.description: AI reads no damage: held for a reviewer (policy v1.1), never rejected.

held_technical_retrying.description: The photo check failed for a technical reason: held while the retry is scheduled.

held_technical_reviewer.description: The photo check kept failing: its job died and a reviewer will check the claim.

held_waiting_for_reviewer.description: Held until a reviewer looks at the land document (a required component, policy v2).

engine_dead.description: The decision step itself kept failing (a reviewer is notified).

deciding.description: The engine holds the claim's decision lock (state processing).

engine_running.description: The engine step is running on a submitted claim.

more_evidence_required.description: The engine asked for more evidence; a new photo was added and the claim can be resubmitted.

more_evidence_no_photos_limit_reached.description: More evidence needed, no photos at all, and the resubmission limit already reached.

submitted_without_photos.description: Submitted without photos (satellite switched off in this environment).

decided_verified.description: Decided verified; weather was unavailable (supporting only).

decided_by_reviewer.description: A reviewer decided the claim before the automated checks completed.

withdrawn_after_submit.description: Withdrawn by the farmer after submitting.

withdrawn_draft.description: Withdrawn before it was ever submitted.
